name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A card that tilts in 3D toward or away from the pointer and scales up slightly, with an optional spotlight that follows it.
label: Spell UI
author: Spell UI <https://github.com/xxtomm>

props.name: effect
props.description: Tilt toward the pointer, or away from it.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: A soft light that follows the pointer.

props.name: className / style / children
props.description: The card's own styling and content.

a11y: Decorative motion only: it adds no role, and the spotlight layer is aria-hidden; give interactive cards their own button or link inside.
Reduced motion: no tilt and no scale; the spotlight still fades in and follows the pointer.
Pointer driven: keyboard users see the resting card, which carries all of the content.
usage:
<TiltCard tiltLimit={10} className="aspect-video w-[360px] rounded-2xl bg-card p-6">
  …
</TiltCard>
